faqs.question: Does Mody University of Science and Technology accept CAT score?

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) + Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Dissatisfied with faculty members and placements in 2025 but infrastructure is good.

review_content.Placements: There are no such good placements offered this year. Only sales companies are coming in which few are fraud as well, having police complain over them, and scamming students. But they guarantee 100% placements. Last year the highest package was 6 LPA - 7 LPA for BBA. For MBA the average salary ranges between 8 LPA - 9 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite great of this college with great library, labs, and classrooms. But hostels are not quite safe nowadays and a lot of illegal things are been done there. The food quality of food is average, no such good medical facilities are available there.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: The best college with a really fascinating campus.

review_content.Placements: 80-85% of students get placed in my course. The highest package offered in my course ranges from 6 LPA - 7 LPA. The lowest package is 2 LPA. The average package varies between 4 LPA - 5 LPA. TCS, Infosys, and Wipro are some of the top companies in my course. Internships are generally not guaranteed. But at least 70-80% of students are offered internships by companies like Infosys, TCS, etc. Roles offered are data analyst, data scientist, web developer, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at Mody University is very fabulous. It has a Wi-Fi connection overall in the building. There are well-facilitated labs and it is very big. There is a huge library and classrooms are also very clean and digitalised. Hostels are very hygienic. The food is also very nice. Mody gives a nice platform for a sports person, it also keeps track offer physical health.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Campus of college is very aesthetic.

review_content.Placements: Placement rates are very high. Every student gets placed in top companies if someone is not capable they also get some package. The highest package is 6 LPA-7 LPA for BCA students. Top companies are Accenture, Deloitte, Amazon, and Myntra. Top roles offered are web developer, data science, digital marketer, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very nice from mess to different labs everything is available as per requirement. Library also has all books for different courses. Hostels are also well managed and get cleaned every day. Rooms are also spacious. University campus includes many grounds for all sports both indoor and outdoor.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Campus is very good and aesthetic.

review_content.Placements: It doesn't have placement for BCA and MCA they promised full placement and now they are not referring even one company for BCA. There are at least 30-40 companies for B. Tech and not for BCA they even keep students neglected. And doesn't even worth the money also.
review_content.Infrastructure: Food quality is good but it's not worth the fees they receive. Hostel room quality is very good. Food is also sometimes good and sometimes not good but we get sweets for dinner every day which is the best part. Food according to festivals is also served.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: I would recommend Mody University as it has the best campus and best facilities.

review_content.Placements: Mody University has an 85% placement rate here and the maximum is 5 LPA, with the minimum being 2 LPA for BCA. Many companies like Flipkart, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Visa, etc., visit for placements. Top roles are software and web developer, data analyst, cyber security analyst, etc. My college has a great percentage of students getting placed. The top companies also prefer it more than your University. It is NAAC A+ rated. It is rated as the best women's University in the Asia Pacific by ASSOCHAM.
review_content.Infrastructure: Mody University has Wi-Fi available for all, very well-facilitated labs, smart classrooms, and a huge library. The hostel is quite nice, and the food is very healthy as everything is done inside the campus. The hostels are very well cleaned, and it has 200+ faculty members and 7 different schools according to your field.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Mody University: In Revel and in Real

review_content.Placements: 100% of students were placed according to the college, but none of us have received the offer letters yet. The highest package was 8.5 LPA, and the lowest was 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies included Bajaj Finance Limited, Colgate Palmolive, Jaro Education, Light Solution, ICICI Prudential, ICICI Securities, Smytten, 99 Acres, PepsiCo, Collebra, and Varun Beverages. None of us got internships from the college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is just awesome, with labs, smart classrooms with air conditioning, and Wi-Fi. The hostel is also excellent, offering all facilities including mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports and games. Proper security is available, and transportation within the campus is also provided.

faqs.answer: Mody University of Science and Technology provides a unique opportunity for female students all over the world to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate programs through MUSAT (Mody University Scholarship cum Admission Test). The admission process involves three simple steps:Step 1: Fill and submit the application form online.Step 2: Download the PDF of the application form from the website, fill it in, and send it along with a Demand Draft of INR 1000 drawn in favour of "Mody University of Science and Technology", payable at Lakshmangarh or Sikar. Mail it to the Central Admissions Office.Step 3: You can obtain the prospectus and application form in person from the Mody University of Science and Technology, Lakshmangarh office, upon payment of INR 1000 in cash.
faqs.question: Q: What is the admission process for Mody University?

faqs.answer: Mody University of Science and Technology offers entrance-based admission to some of its UG, PG and PhD courses, such as BTech, BArch, MBA, BA LLB and others. Further, for some courses like BA, BCA, Bcom, MCom, and others university offers merit-based admission. Candidates looking for admission to any of these courses must appear for various entrance exams which includes CAT/XAT/NMAT/CMAT/MAT/ATMA/GMAT/JEE Main/ Mody University Entrance Test and other. Further, for direct admission, candidates are required to pass Class 10 and Class 12 for UG courses and pass graduation degree for PG courses.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with faculty members and placements in 2025 but infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite great of this college with great library, labs, and classrooms. But hostels are not quite safe nowadays and a lot of illegal things are been done there. The food quality of food is average, no such good medical facilities are available there.

reviews.review_heading: The best college with a really fascinating campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at Mody University is very fabulous. It has a Wi-Fi connection overall in the building. There are well-facilitated labs and it is very big. There is a huge library and classrooms are also very clean and digitalised. Hostels are very hygienic. The food is also very nice. Mody gives a nice platform for a sports person, it also keeps track offer physical health.

reviews.review_heading: Campus of college is very aesthetic.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very nice from mess to different labs everything is available as per requirement. Library also has all books for different courses. Hostels are also well managed and get cleaned every day. Rooms are also spacious. University campus includes many grounds for all sports both indoor and outdoor.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is very good and aesthetic.
reviews.review_text: Food quality is good but it's not worth the fees they receive. Hostel room quality is very good. Food is also sometimes good and sometimes not good but we get sweets for dinner every day which is the best part. Food according to festivals is also served.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend Mody University as it has the best campus and best facilities.
reviews.review_text: Mody University has Wi-Fi available for all, very well-facilitated labs, smart classrooms, and a huge library. The hostel is quite nice, and the food is very healthy as everything is done inside the campus. The hostels are very well cleaned, and it has 200+ faculty members and 7 different schools according to your field.

reviews.review_heading: Mody University: In Revel and in Real
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just awesome, with labs, smart classrooms with air conditioning, and Wi-Fi. The hostel is also excellent, offering all facilities including mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports and games. Proper security is available, and transportation within the campus is also provided.

reviews.review_heading: Make you career mood happy with mody University.
reviews.review_text: Overall, college infrastructure is good, but MBA buildings have weird infrastructure. You will find peacocks and temples in the campus area. The college annual festival, Unayaan, is celebrated on a large scale in November. Teachers provide study material; notes and books are available in the library. Colleges have Wi-Fi. You can search for any information by sitting in classrooms, but you are restricted to downloading movies from Wi-Fi. Classroom amenities are good; they provide comfortable chai...

reviews.review_heading: The placement rate is good and overall, other things are fine.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is amazing; bad air conditioning labs and a well-equipped library are the best. To be honest, if you live on campus, you are not allowed to leave or order food, and the mess food is terrible. Students are dissatisfied with the food quality.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Mody University.
reviews.review_text: All the basic facilities were provided at the university, such as Wi-Fi, library, labs, etc. The hostel too had all the basic necessities such as tables, mattresses, etc. The quality of food was pretty good, but the taste could be better. There is a clinic on campus, but it is not free. There are courts and grounds for almost all the commonly played sports. There is a horse-riding ground too, and a lot of students get involved in one or more sports.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing Mody University of Science and Technology.
reviews.review_text: All our Laboratories are filled with highly equipped instruments which are needed for practicals. A large number of faculty members and technicians work here. Around 60+ buses are running regularly from our college campus. All the medical facilities are available within our campus.

reviews.review_heading: Get the best experience with Mody University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is excellent, having thousands of trees and herbs, birds, peacock and other beauties. Wi-Fi is available 24*7 and the classroom is comfortable with smart boards, air airconditioning and very comfortable sitting amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Top-notch Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The university boasts top-notch infrastructure. The expansive and scenic surroundings feature trees, mountains, and various flowers, creating a pleasant environment. The library is spacious and well-stocked with books. Classrooms are large, and the labs are well-equipped with modern facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A best college which provides good placement opportunity!
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilis one of the best facility in Mody University. You will find one of the best hostel facility in private colleges in Rajasthan. Here you will get rooms on double and triple sharing basis. Rooms are available in both AC and NON AC format. Food served in the mess is proper food with no onion and garlic in it.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money, time, and a life time experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure plays an important role before choosing any college because it does help us shape us. This college have great infra with good facilities and greenery around. There are around more than 20 hostel building with emmense facilities there and a horse Riding ground, football, hockey, bollyball and many more sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Mody University of Science and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. There are well-established and well-maintained classrooms. Our labs are equipped with high-end IBM and Accenture systems. Our college infrastructure is excellent. The mess food is good.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Health Service Management - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the faculty and management of the Apollo Institute.

content.Placements: At this college, students get good placement opportunities in our course. Around 40-45% of the students get placements in the hospital management course. The average package offered was between 3-5 LPA. Top recruiters at the college were ASG Eye, Apollo Hospital, MGM Hospital, etc. Top roles offered were health service coordinator, healthcare executive, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Apollo Institute has good infrastructure for this course. The college offers various facilities such as a library, canteen, Wi-Fi, labs, hostel, sports, and medical facilities to its students. Hostel facilities include furnished rooms and good food in the mess available for the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Critical Care Technology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Advanced Critical Care technology .

content.Placements: 95% student get job after passing the course into various hospital and nursing home. The highest package of this college students is 6lpa and the lowest package is 1.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Apollo Hospital, Ruby General Hospital, SSKM, Fortis, you can be critical care technician in charge after 2-3 years of experience .
content.Infrastructure: The college has a big library filled with various course book like MBBS MD critical care technology and nursing. The college campus is fully Wi-Fi, and the labs high level with filled all essential, the classroom are well with air conditioned. The food of hospital canteen is very bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Radiotherapy Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: Every year, 70 to 80 students get admitted to total batches. Internships are offered at Apollo Hospitals and Tata Memorial Hospitals. The salary package offered in our course is 0.9 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Amenities provided are average. The college only provides hostel and canteen facilities for female students from other states. Clinical postings are given batch by batch.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified. The teaching quality is good. The teaching is understandable. The course curriculum is different. Exams are conducted by Dr. MGR Medical University. Internal exams are compulsory to pass university exams. The pass percentage is 99%.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia Technology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am extremely satisfied to study in the college .

content.Placements: Around 98% of students were placed according to their scores get in the exam. All the top specialised hospitals are recurring the job for this course. They are providing 1-year internships to Students with a stipend and train you based on the course.
content.Infrastructure: Well-specialised classroom with air conditioning, modern library with Wi-Fi connection, computer labs, physiology, and anatomical lab are available. Infrastructure is well ventilated and a playground is available. The hostel is available only for girls and has no hostel for boys.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Physician Assistance - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Good campus and faculty. Friendly seniors, good clinical postings & excellent internship.

content.Placements: AIHMAS is one of the best medical colleges for Allied sciences. B.Sc. Physician assistant is a 4-years course including 1 year of compulsory Internship that should be done in a branch of Apollo hospitals. Most of the students are placed in top corporate Hospitals as Surgical assistants, OP PAs and Clinical assistants in IPs and ICUs. The average package for a fresher is around 15-20K.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is huge. And it is surrounded by beautiful trees. Classrooms are well lit, Labs are equipped well. The library has a vast collection of best medical books. Can also access seniors' project reports and thesis. The mess provides healthy food as well.

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech at Sri Sairam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: BTech is one of the flagship courses provided at Sri Sairam Engineering College. The total tuition fees for the BTech course is around INR 2 Lacs to 2.5 Lacs . The course is offered in full-time mode for 4 years. SSREC Chennai admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The college considers Class 12 score for BE/ BTech programme. The college offers courses at UG and PG levels in Engineering and Management streams. Interested candidates can fill out the admission form on the official website.

faqs.question: What is the fees range for courses offerred by the Sri Sai Ram Engineering College?
faqs.answer: The fees range for courses offerred by the Sri Sai Ram Engineering College is around INR 35000 - INR 250000.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for Sri Sairam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Candidates have to pay an application fee to register for accepted entrance exams. Sri Sairam Engineering College considers Class 12 score and TNEA Counselling for BE/ BTech. The application fee for TNEA is INR 500 for the general candidates and INR 250 for the SC /SCA /ST category belonging to Tamil Nadu. The college considers CEETA-PG and TANCET scores for M.Tech and MBA respectively. Aspirants have to pay an application fee INR 1,800 + GST for CEETA PG and INR 1,000 for TANCET. There is a relaxation in the fee for reserved category candidates.

faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee of the MBA programme at Sri Sairam Engineering College?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee of the MBA programme at Sri Sairam Engineering College is INR 35,000. This is the tuition fee of two-year MBA programme and does not iclude additional cost like mess fee or hostel fee. The fee is taken from unoffical sources and hence, is indicative.

admission_process.title: Akemi School of Business Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Akemi School of Business admission 2025are open. Candidates willing to secure a seat are required to visit the official website and fill out the online application form. Before applying to theAkemi School of Businesscourses, the candidates are advised to check the eligibility and selection criteria. The college offers a two-year, full-time, residential,AICTE-approved MBA + MDP coursein five different specialisations and four complementary specialisations.The course isaffiliated withSavitribai Phule Pune University.
Read on to learn more aboutAkemi School of Business admission process 2025.

Candidates seeking admission toAkemi School of Business coursesmust start their admission process by meeting the course-specific eligibility criteria. Eligible candidates are then required to apply to the course through the official website and then go through the pre-determined selection process.

reviews.review_heading: Best Option for Management student to pursue in Pune University.
reviews.review_text: Facility and infrastructure are good. The campus is not that big but has good vibes and a beautiful campus. Ground area is there and classes are also good. Faculty members are cooperative, helpful, and supportive. They provide guidance to the students and help them, assist them towards the right path. Hostel is good with power backup, facilities, security, food, and connectivity with the city.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: Campus is also good. It is not much big but it is enough to get the vibe of the college and enjoy with my batchmates. Classrooms have the space to settle down 50-60 students at a time. 1-1 interaction with faculty members is done. Library is also good. Full campus is Wi-fi. Hostels are out of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: This is the worst college, there are no placements at all and not even proper faculty.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel over here. The college campus area is so small that there are only a few classrooms available for the sake of teaching. The MBA course might be overrated now but it still has demand in the market if proper placement is provided.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best B-schools in whole Maharashtra and best in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text:
We have one of the best hostel facilities including gym, food and cleanliness. We have following facilities available 
1) Gym 
2) Cafeteria 
3) Secutity facilities 
4) Power Back up 
5) Clubs 
6) Dining area
7) sports 
8) Best Connectivity from the main city.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Akemi Business School.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are air-conditioned. There is a computer lab with 80 computers. There is a library which has a wide variety of books and magazines related to various fields. There is also a hostel within 800 meters from the campus. The hostel provides breakfast, lunch and dinner for students. It also provides facilities like free Wi-Fi, LED TV and laundry services.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and helpful faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities available on the campus are amongst the very best. A standby power generator is provided on the campus to take care of the occasional power shut down due to maintenance. A campus-wide wireless computing network is in the place that allows faculty, staff and students to access the internet at any point of time. There are separate hostels for boys and girls, and the hostel facilities are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good placements. It helps to grow your knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Learning facilities like computer labs, AC classrooms, sports ground, etc., are available in our college. It's a huge campus. We have facilities like snacks, food items, etc., in our college. The food offered is 100% pure vegetarian. This campus encourages students for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and all facilities.
reviews.review_text: The network, PG bus, classrooms, library, books, and all notes were available. Labs and hostel were best. The bed and all facilities, Wi-Fi network computer labs, and games, sports, were provided. The college campus had the best quality canteen, best facilities and good.

reviews.review_heading: Best college of Pune University.
reviews.review_text: College is having world class infrastructure and good environment for study. College maintain its own hostel. Hostel has all the facilities such as mess, sports facilities, gym. Hygiene is maintained. Room cleaning and laundry is available which is already included in the fee.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a wise choice to go for if you need a good college with minimum fees .
reviews.review_text: The classroom is very decent, and the college has Wi-Fi but not a dedicated one for students. However, there are a lot of activities done on campus and events are held. The canteen is clean and the food is good. Hostel facility is available; however, it is not mandatory.

reviews.review_heading: College has a great dynamic Learning Environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my course is well good. And the facilities are modern and well-equipped, making the learning experience truly enriching. It is a great environment to excel in studies and explore new opportunities. Definitely impressive with the setup.

reviews.review_heading: Best in terms of ROI, Supportive faculty, Good Campuses and Certification.
reviews.review_text: Overall satisfied with the college. Not a very hi-fi campus but a campus with a very altruistic environment and supportive faculty. College was always my second home. Mess food is okay in taste, but you can find a lot of good eating options in Pune. College events were the cherry on the cake.

reviews.review_heading: Best and in budget college in Pune with MBA + MDP programs .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well-built, and all facilities are available on campus like Wi-Fi, labs, and the library. Everything on campus is so good; the canteen is clean, and the college has exam sports areas. Mess food is also good; overall, everything is perfect at Akemi Business School.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in terms of ROI and exposure.
reviews.review_text: The college is equipped with great facilities for the student body. We have good tech- facilities, sports ground, labs, spacious classrooms and overall the vibe of the campus is quite lively. Even the hostel was a great space to be in. I met some of the best people here and made memories that would last me for a lifetime.

content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is average, not particularly impressive, but adequate. Each classroom is equipped with a smart board and digital board. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, including the hostel and cafeteria. However, the hostel facilities are basic; you will only have a bed, a table, a chair, and a personal cupboard.
content.Faculty: All faculty members are good, helpful, and very friendly to every student. They are knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is very good across the board. Semester exams can be challenging, so you need to work hard to succeed.

placement_data.title: KIT Kanpur Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: The Kanpur Institute of Technology has yet to publish its complete placement report for 2025. As stated on the Official Website, there were a total of 3,000 placements during the 2025 placement season at Kanpur Institute of Technology. The highest salary package awarded to students was INR 25 LPA. More than 200 companies participated in the 2025 placement drive at KIT. Earlier in 2024 the KIT Kanpur placement percentage stood at 87%. The highest package bagged by the students was INR 10 LPA, and the average package stood at INR 2.50 LPA. More than 391 job offers were made. A total of 105 companies participated and selected 552 students.

Kanpur Institute of Technology has a skill development cell that focuses on upgrading skills to international standards through significant industry involvement. The institute also has a Placements and Corporate Relations Cell (PCRC) that engages with industry and constantly strives to expand the industry-academia interface. The cell conducts training sessions, seminars, and many important webinars to update students’ skills in all formats according to global market requirements. KIT Kanpur has also organised various industrial visits to Havells Pvt. Ltd., Baddi, BHEL Ltd., Haridwar, Brooks Laboratories Ltd., Chandigarh, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, good infrastructure and a helpful faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our department has modern labs, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, and a well-stocked library. Hostel rooms are clean and secure, the mess food is hygienic, the canteen offers a variety, and medical support. Sports grounds and indoor games ensure a balanced campus life.

reviews.review_heading: Don't take admission here if you want better college life. If you want a degree, then go for it.
reviews.review_text: Labs and library are top-notch, except there's always a network issue in the college. No Wi-Fi is provided. Medical facilities are average. Sports and games facilities are good. Mess and canteen food are below average. No non-veg is allowed inside the college, not even in the mess.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, supportive faculty members, and strong placements at KIT.
reviews.review_text: KIT offers excellent infrastructure with modern labs, Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, and a well-stocked library for the CSE department. Hostels are comfortable. The mess serves hygienic food. Medical facilities and vibrant sports grounds add to campus life. Overall, college provides a great environment for learning and growth.

reviews.review_heading: KIT Kanpur - Affordable engineering with strong CSE placements and supportive campus.
reviews.review_text: Smart classrooms with projectors, AC in most of the rooms, and well-equipped labs with the latest systems and tools. We have large library with books, journals, and provide e-resources. We have high-speed internet access throughout campus, fully functional workshops, and AC seminar halls used for training and events.

reviews.review_heading: I experienced the best at this college.
reviews.review_text: I am using campus Wi-Fi regularly and I haven't faced any issues yet, and the library is so silent for study and fully air-conditioned. The hostel is good, but I face some issues in the hostel mess. The size of the hostel rooms is so good, and they provide all the equipment for sports.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, supportive faculty, and decent infrastructure for CSE students.
reviews.review_text: The CSE department has a good infrastructure with smart classrooms and well-equipped computer labs. Hostel facilities are decent. The mess food is average, and medical help is available on campus. Sports and indoor games are also provided. It is a very good college for students who belong to middle-class families.

reviews.review_heading: Kanpur Institute of Technology is the dream chaser.
reviews.review_text: This college had a prestigious infrastructure and a very environment-friendly atmosphere with three huge grounds. It also provided space in the library, labs, computer labs, and centralized AC classrooms. They had delicious food in their canteen along with some food stalls on the ground. The mess, canteen, hostels (for girls and boys), medical facilities, sports, and games. KIT provides the best services in all these areas.

reviews.review_heading: I would rate 4 out of 5 for the college life.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and the library are provided with AC. Wi-Fi is also available. I am not a hostel student, but according to me, the hostel food is average. Sports events are organised on a regular basis. Students are free to play and practice sports.

reviews.review_heading: Our respected HOD is the one I really look upto.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. There is Wi-Fi available. There are vast labs (multiple labs). Classrooms available can fill up to more than 100 students. There is a library available and every book is there. You will also find clean washrooms. There is also cold water available (drinkable). There is a canteen. There is also a garden. There are 3 parking areas, and playground is also available.

reviews.review_heading: My college is very good, and it is an autonomous college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of my college are too good. There are airy classrooms and many courses are available. The infrastructure of my college is also good. The hostel facility is good and the quality of food in the mess as well as canteen is great. Medical facilities and extracurricular activities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of faculty, good placement in 2021, and really good infrastructure
reviews.review_text: The campus provides Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a fantastic library. The quality of food in the hostel is very good. The library has a very quiet area, and the classrooms are very clean. The hostel provides hygienic food. The hostel rooms are really good and clean.

reviews.review_heading: My college experience review.
reviews.review_text: KIT was one of the best colleges in Kanpur for graduation because, nowadays, it has become an autonomous college and the first private college in Kanpur. Inside the college, there were three buildings named KIHE, KITP, and KIT, which were the main building for B. Tech and MCA courses. The college provided many facilities like a big playground area with indoor sports, a canteen, 24/7 Wi-Fi with good area coverage, and many more. Labs and classrooms were well-furnished with centralized AC. Facilit...

reviews.review_heading: A short review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is like moderate, but you can also say good. Here some lecture theatres LTs are available in which projectors for a better teaching and understanding experience. There are many computer labs in which 700+ computers are available.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college with good teachers and infrastructure. But it lacks transparency in placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent. I am a day scholar, so I do not know about the hostel infrastructure. The library is big, covering two floors. Classrooms are equipped with air conditioners and projectors. Medical facilities are also good, and there are many sports you can choose to play like cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, carrom, chess, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Kanpur Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, the food provided by the college is vegetarian. They provide 3 meals a day which is sufficient for me. The hostel room is good but they charge more money for the hostel as compared to other colleges. At last, the infrastructure is good enough to live in a hostel.

The hostels are separate for boys and girls, with single/double sharing, and while some reviews praise their cleanliness and facilities, others mention small rooms and issues with mess food quality.

I am not a hostel student, which means I don’t live in the hostel, so I don’t know much about the hostel facilities, but according to my friends (who used to live in the hostel), it doesn’t offer many amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the placement.
reviews.review_text: The modern campus (~10 acres, shared with GGITS) features smart classrooms, labs, an auditorium, computer centers, and Wi-Fi, along with a well-stocked library (15k+ books, journals, e-resources), sports facilities like cricket, football, basketball, indoor/outdoor games, and a gymnasium. The hostels are separate for boys and girls, with single/double sharing, and while some reviews praise their cleanliness and facilities, others mention small rooms and issues with mess food quality.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has multiple Wi-Fi networks in different areas, all providing fast and excellent speed. I am not a hostel student, which means I don’t live in the hostel, so I don’t know much about the hostel facilities, but according to my friends (who used to live in the hostel), it doesn’t offer many amenities.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good technical college in Jabalpur and the best placement-giving college in Jabalpur.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is not working, and there are jammers present in all the college. Labs are good. Various types of instruments are available in the lab. The library is not good. The library has some issues that make it less effective for studying. The hostel facilities are good, but the food is average. Sports and games are unavailable during class hours.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average. Theoretical classes are also quite good., but the main thing is that the lab facilities are very good and contain all the essential things for a very good understanding. Libraries are also very good but don't allow us to go.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, you can easily get placed if you listen to your teacher's advice.
reviews.review_text: The college has its hostel approximately 1.5km away and the hostel facility is average in all terms. The college has a Wi-Fi facility but they don't tell its password. The canteen facility is also good in terms of quality food. Labs facility and lab faculty members are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the top colleges for engineering in Jabalpur.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite well as the whole college is built in a rock and plateau area so there is no planet surface and building is normal with the classes and labs. There is a Wi-Fi facility but not good enough to use it and also always there is a network issue.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college where you can pursue your degree.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, and A good internet connection is provided by the college,. There are digital classrooms, and the library consists of all books related to the courses. Sports are arranged by the college. Competitions are held among various colleges. Overall, it is a good.

reviews.review_heading: A college where we can create our future, and good memories together.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are very good. They provide a good internet connection. There are labs, classrooms, and a library, where students can study. There is a canteen also. Sports, like badminton, cricket, and many other sports are being held in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college if students are hardworking.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel in GGCT. Classrooms are so far average but the labs are in good condition. We can do coding by taking permission from the staff if want. There is also a library where we can borrow books. Canteen has very high price while the stationary also takes higher rate items which are actually low quality.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Jabalpur.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for this course include free Wi-Fi for everyone, computer systems for everyone, labs that are very good with digital technology, smart classrooms, and a library that is also very big. The quality of the facilities in my hostel is also good; it has one bed, one almirah, one table, and a chair. The food in the mess is also pretty good, and there are many sports and games available.

reviews.review_heading: "Placement rate is high more students get selected.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very huge and beautiful. Some other courses like B. Teach, M. Teach, Pharma, B.A. and related departments are available. Facilities like Wi-Fi, lab, library, classrooms, hostel, canteen, sports ground, medical facility, everything is here. The canteen food is delicious and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: College is perfect. You need to follow the discipline of the teachers.
reviews.review_text:
Playgrounds for volleyball, cricket, and other courts are also available; you have the ability, so you will go for the intercollegiate level, then go for stage level. These things will provide this college. 
The canteen hostel is very good. 
No medical facilities and opportunities for all sports.

reviews.review_heading: Topmost companies visit, and the rate of selection is very high.
reviews.review_text: In the canteen, a variety of items are available; food quality and taste are acceptable with the maintenance of hygiene. Hostel rooms are fully ventilated, and there is 24/7 water and electricity supply. There is a sports ground, medical facilities, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, a seminar hall, an auditorium, etc.; everything is here.

reviews.review_heading: East or west, only our Gyan Ganga Institute is best.
reviews.review_text: Smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, labs, a stocked library, sports ground, medical facility, seminar hall, auditorium—everything is big and ventilated. The hostel is for both girls and boys, with 24/7 water and electricity supply. Canteen food is awesome; a variety of items is present, and it is prepared in a hygienic manner. Some other courses like BBA, B.Com, B.Tech, M.Tech, and Pharmacy have separate departments.

reviews.review_heading: Best placement opportunities in Jabalpur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really very big and beautiful. Many other courses and related departments are here. Canteen food is hygienic and delicious. Free medical facilities and sports ground are here. The hostel is for both girls and boys, with 24/7 water and electricity supply and a friendly environment. Wi-Fi, labs, library, classroom, seminar hall, auditorium, and everything is available for students.

paragraphs: BRAOU admissions 2025are primarily merit-based. The university accepts state-level entrance exams such asAPICETandTSICETfor MBA admission. In addition, there is an entrance exam for B.Ed and MBA courses.BRAOUoffers a list of courses at the UG, PG, PG Diploma and doctoral levels in distance education mode. The course list includes BA, BCom, MSc, MA, MCom, etc. Candidates can apply online on the official website of the university forBRAOU admission.

Dr Br Ambedkar Open University offers BA, BCom, BSc, B.L.I.Sc and B.Ed courses at the undergraduate level. The University offers MA, MSc, MCom, MBA and M.L.I at the postgraduate level courses. Candidates willing to seek General MBA admission atDr. BRAOUneed to appear for the entrance exam. The university will evaluate the applications of the candidates for educational qualification. The merit of the candidate's in the previous qualifying exam is considered for admission. For MBA, the selection is done based on the aspirant's score in APICET/ TSICET/BRAOU MBA ETfollowed by group discussion and personal interview rounds.

After the candidates have submitted their application, the university will review their applications and make an admission decision. They are informed of the decision via email or through the university's website.

college_info.intro:
Manav Rachna University offers BTech and MBA programmes to students as its flagship programmes. These courses are offered to students at the UG and PG levels for a duration of 4 and 2 years, respectively. The university offers a BTech programme in several specialisations such as Computer Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics and Artificial Engineering, etc.
Manav Rachna University courses are AICTE-approved and are offered in full-time mode. The university also offers various specialisations under its MBA programme, namely HR Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Finance Analytics, and Operations & Supply Chain Analytics. Candidates can check some of the popular programmes offered at Manav Rachna University, along with the eligibility criteria and the total course fees, in the table provided below:
For more information about Manav Rachna University [MRU] check out the below video:

placements.overview:
Manav Rachna University is a private university and is located in Faridabad. Earlier, in 2004, it was known as the Manav Rachna College of Engineering (MRCE), that later got evolved into Manav Rachna University (MRU) in 2014. It is a UGC-recognised university and has been accredited by the NAAC with an A grade. All the Technical programmes offered by the university are approved by the AICTE. Manav Rachna University comprises more than 5 schools that offer various UG, PG, and PhD programmes in the fields of Law, Management, Technology, Sciences, and others.

The university has been ranked in the band of 201-300 by the NIRF 2025 in the BTech category. It has also ranked 51 by the India Today 2025 in the BBA category. Manav Rachna University courses are offered to students at the UG and PG levels, mainly in Engineering, Management, Science, Law, and Computer Application streams. Some of the popular courses offered by the university are , BBA, BSc, , MBA, and MTech.

Manav Rachna University admissions are open for the year 2026. The university provides a wide range of programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. Some of the popular courses offered at the university are BTech, BSc, BBA, MBA, MTech, etc. Manav Rachna University course admission is both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts its entrance exam by the name of Manav Rachna National Aptitude Test (MRNAT) for providing admission to various courses.

reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied because of the good faculty, helping mentors, and extracurricular activities.

review_content.Placements: 70% of students get placed on campus placements and others go off-campus placements. The highest package ranges from 14-20 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA, but it can vary. Companies like Thoughtworks, LTIMindtree, HCL, etc., hire students. 30-40% of students get internships in companies like National Instruments, etc. Software developer roles are preferred here.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available. Labs and libraries are pretty good. There are many libraries inside the campus only where students can study. It is decent. The food is good and healthy and as a college student, it is satisfying. Medical facilities are available on the campus. Sports tournaments are also conducted.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) in Association with Xebia - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, it is a fine college, but I would recommend that there are better colleges with same fees.

review_content.Placements: Till date, the highest package is 60 LPA from the 2023 batch. The average is somewhere around 5-6 LPA, but that too if you are good at what you want to do. Placement is decent, not too bad, but there are better options than this college if I have to be brutally honest.
review_content.Infrastructure: If I have to talk about classrooms, they are decently okay. There are all the basic facilities in a class, like Wi-Fi, etc. But if we talk about hostels, they aren't worth the amount you are spending. Rooms are just fine, but toilets are barely usable. The Wi-Fi in the hostel isn't the best and barely functions. Now, if we talk about the mess, the food served here is mostly just trash. The laundry service gives you clothes almost a week later, and sometimes clothes aren't washed properly.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the faculty members and they are very helpful.

review_content.Placements: The highest salary package offered in the previous year was 55 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2 LPA. Many companies like TCS, Dyson, etc., visit the college for placements. Many students got unpaid internships and many students got paid internships as they vary by student.
review_content.Infrastructure: I am not a hostel student, but my friend told me that is nice but not so good. Our college provides Wi-Fi, classrooms, clean labs, and proper computer setup. The library is full of books, either knowledgeable, funny or modern technology in sports. There are many clubs at the college and university levels.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Manav Rachna University is a university one should join to enjoy campus life.

review_content.Placements: I don't remember the exact amount but around 80% of students got placement in my course. As we all know the packages vary according to our knowledge. The highest salary package offered is 18 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 4 LPA - 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: They provide good facilities like a gaming zone (indoor games), outdoor games, and good Wi-Fi speed throughout the campus. Libraries and classrooms are also good. And yes you will love our food courts.
review_content.Faculty: To join a college, faculty members play an important role. I can say that our faculty members are very supportive and of good nature. Students can easily build a good bond with them. They are also highly qualified and teaching quality is good. This course will properly make you industry-ready. Exams are quite tough so be ready.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Business Analytics in collaboration with ISDC - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Good college, value for money.

review_content.Placements: 20 percent were placed. I don't know the highest and the lowest package offered by HR, and I don't know about the packages of the students as I was not in touch with the friends and faculty for a long time. But yes, it was average as I know till now.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good amenities provided by the college, and the infrastructure was also very nice. The canteen was very good as there were 3 places to eat with different options. A Nescafé and a Subway were also there to chill and have food with friends and spend time.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: If your home is near MRU you can definitely take admission.

review_content.Placements: My university has a good placement record. About 70% of students who study seriously get placed easily. The top recruiters are TCS, Capgemini, Infosys, Genpact, and American Express. The majority of us became computer science engineers through B.Tech. About 60% of students get internships, and the rest have to do a compulsory course. The companies offering internships are the same as those offering placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is very good and well maintained. The college provides excellent facilities, including Wi-Fi, labs, and three libraries, each with a different purpose. The library is quiet, and students can study there from 8 am to 4 pm. The entire college is air conditioned. For sports, we have a basketball court, a cricket ground, a football ground, and an indoor sports arena. All the playing grounds and equipment are well maintained. The canteen food is very good, but a bit expensive. The food in the mess is okay, but it is affordable, and they try to offer a variety of dishes. Overall, we enjoy our meals at the college.

Many companies like TCS, Dyson, etc., visit the college for placements. Many students got unpaid internships and many students got paid internships as they vary by student.
content.Infrastructure: I am not a hostel student, but my friend told me that is nice but not so good. Our college provides Wi-Fi, classrooms, clean labs, and proper computer setup. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Manav Rachna University is a university one should join to enjoy campus life.

content.Placements: I don't remember the exact amount but around 80% of students got placement in my course. As we all know the packages vary according to our knowledge. The highest salary package offered is 18 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 4 LPA - 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: They provide good facilities like a gaming zone (indoor games), outdoor games, and good Wi-Fi speed throughout the campus. Libraries and classrooms are also good. And yes you will love our food courts.
content.Faculty: To join a college, faculty members play an important role. I can say that our faculty members are very supportive and of good nature. Students can easily build a good bond with them. They are also highly qualified and teaching quality is good. This course will properly make you industry-ready. Exams are quite tough so be ready.

content.Placements: 20 percent were placed. I don't know the highest and the lowest package offered by HR, and I don't know about the packages of the students as I was not in touch with the friends and faculty for a long time. But yes, it was average as I know till now.
content.Infrastructure: Good amenities provided by the college, and the infrastructure was also very nice. The canteen was very good as there were 3 places to eat with different options. A Nescafé and a Subway were also there to chill and have food with friends and spend time.

reviews.review_heading: Good college if you really want to study.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is so good, and maintenance is also good. Food is average. Any difficulty or problem with the electrical side, they take immediate action to solve the problem. Only food is not much better. They provide us with average food. They provide non-veg weekly for 4 days.

reviews.review_heading: College is strict and has good facilities, but the faculty and events need improvement.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is well maintained with clean classrooms well equipped labs and a library stocked with sufficient books. WiFi facilities are available across the campus especially in the labs and library. The hostel is decent and well maintained with clean and comfortable rooms. The food provided in the hostel mess is average but there is a canteen on campus for snacks. Medical facilities are available within the campus and students can participate in sports such as cricket volleyball and...

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the food in the hostel.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms and maintenance are good. The food they provide is not that good. We have to report the fault in the room, and the hostel management will take action in a short time. They don't take more time to solve the fault. Only the food is limited and not that good. Weekly, 4 days, non-vegetarian food is served. It provides snacks in the evening.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities were good and excellent.
reviews.review_text: My college has a good network, providing high-speed Wi-Fi connection and internet access across campus. There is modern equipment for hands-on learning in Science, engineering, and specialized research. Classrooms have digital boards, projectors, and comfortable seating to enhance learning. There is also a vast collection of books in libraries, journals, and research papers, often with online access to e-resources.

reviews.review_heading: An honest review about K. Ramakrishnan College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: If you talk about the facilities and infrastructure, there are Wi-Fi connections all over our college campus and also facilitated classrooms and a library with thousands of books. If we talk about the quality of our hostel, it may be something average because the food was so low, and not many students studied in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: A small review of K Ramakrishnan College of Engineering from my point of view.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms were clean and neat. Also, most labs are available, and there are good libraries with a large number of books. When you talk about the hostel, there may be small food problems in our college, like the quality, but otherwise, the food was good. Maybe small issues happen sometimes. Medical facilities are available 24/7, and the canteen food was good.

reviews.review_heading: If you need to gain knowledge, its a good place but not for your freedom.
reviews.review_text: In my college, infrastructure is better. Hostel facility is not good. In our college, we have canteen facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and environment .
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are the best. In our department, Wi-Fi facilities are provided, and labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are clean, and libraries have many books where we need to give ID cards for books. The quality of food is good in the canteen and mess.

reviews.review_heading: Many students are friends of mine in this college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are very good. The college infrastructure is excellent, with a pleasant and well-lit environment. We have Wi-Fi access, well-equipped labs, and a library. Hostel facilities are also good, and the food is satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Golden days of my college life .
reviews.review_text: Courses are good in the college, and also campus life is too good and neat when compared to a hostel. In a hostel, the total control is taken by Zolo Stays, so it is very neat and clean. And they will provide free popcorn with theatre-type movies for everyone once a week, and also they cut the cake for the hostel students free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college environment and facilities .
reviews.review_text: Our college has a huge library. Each department has separate labs. Each floor has separate Wi-Fi, and classrooms have educom facilities. The college hostel has AC and non-AC facilities, and the mess food is moderate. Separate the canteen for vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Our college has a separate sports club, and they support the students to participate in various events.

reviews.review_heading: It is an okay college, but not that good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available are Wi-Fi, labs, and computers. But they can improve some more. The library has a reasonable number of books. The quality of the rooms is okay. But the AC rooms are so good. But food is not that good. It is spicier in nature. They use ready-made parathas and chapatis.

reviews.review_heading: How is life at KRCE Trichy?
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are non AC, and hostel rooms and foods are not that much worthy. Ill rate it around 6.5 to 10. canteen has absolutely tasty and catch foods, which is worth the hype krce. When it comes to sports, no sports quota will be considered here. But they will give you cash rewards if you won any prize. I ve got 25k for being selected for anna university women volleyball team 2023 and I had participated in all india south zone tournament which was held at Kerala on dec 2022. they will ...

reviews.review_heading: Education is a good weapon for future.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is looking good. It was very clean and green with filled of trees. Our campus is maintained by the NSS Cubs. There are two blocks in our campus separately one for Engineering and other for Technology block. Wi-fi facilities are also provided in our classrooms and labs.

reviews.review_heading: KRCE placements and training review.
reviews.review_text: The students are handled in a friendly way and are given opportunities to participate in the inter and intra college events. Hostels are very comfortable and well maintained at all times. The quality of food is very nice and we like the food prepared in the mess.

overview_faqs.question: Is SVU - Shri Venkateshwara University a good college?

In 2023, it was ranked 1201 out of 1799 internationally. A very good university campus with experienced faculty and good options for placements. The infrastructure is quite good with classrooms and labs well furnished.

review_summary.college_name: Shri Venkateshwara University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with faculty members. Infrastructure is good.

content.Placements: All 250 students got placed from course. The highest is no limit but the lowest is 13 LPA. Students themselves get their further education by NEET PG. 100% of students of MBBS got internships. We are provided with a family adoption program which surely enhances our communication skills.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are equipped with AC and lecture hall with projector and electronic podium. Ground is available with multiple playable games like cricket, football, etc. Canteen is available with 24/7 supply of milk and eatables. Hostel facility is available with AC rooms, laundry, and sweeper facilities. Rooms are better than any college in NCR.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college for top and average students.

content.Placements: My percentage is 78% in B.Sc. mathematics. The salary package depends on marks and interviews. MNCs and IT companies hire our college students and provide the best packages. Companies like LTI, TCS, Accenture, IBM, Oracle, Infosys, and Microsoft visit our college. It is the best university for all students.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides the best facilities like classrooms and a well-maintained library. The hostel facility, a canteen, medical facilities, and sports are very good.
content.Faculty: Higher teaching quality often correlates with engaging lessons, practical applications of knowledge, and support for students' learning styles. Seek feedback from current or past students about their experiences in class. Programs that offer hands-on projects, internships, and interactions with industry professionals typically prepare students better for the workforce. Check if there are any capstone projects or case studies included in the curriculum. Teachers always help students with any doubt questions. They never say no to any problems.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, good placements really good infrastructure and facilities .

content.Placements: In Shri Venketeshwara university, Internship is compulsory for all students who pursuing MBBS for 1 year and they give stipend 12000 per month. Approximately 50 percentage students get job and the highest and average package offer and after MBBS course, we can apply anywhere for job in any hospital.
content.Infrastructure: It has a good infrastructure and they provide us free Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library and gym. Faculty is good, calm, polite we can ask any doubts related to topics without any fear or hesitation. They are very cooperative .

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with teachers and good placements for 2015, and the packages are good.

content.Placements: Around 86% of students were placed in our college. The highest salary package offered was 12 LPA, and the lowest salary pacakge offered was 6 LPA. Companies like Morgan Stanley on the other hand, the top Indian companies at Tata Consultancy Services, Reliance, Cognizant, Wipro, ICICI Bank, etc.
content.Infrastructure: In this college, the hostels were nearby. Attach various infrastructure facilities as common television, telephone, tables, and chairs sector. They were modern gym, and sports equipment was provided. it also provides an auditorium, and medical centers were available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: College is still under construction, not good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Approximately 70 to 75 percent of student were placed and the highest and average salary offered to students were 10 Lacs p. a. and 2 Lacs p. a. respectively. Top recruiting companies like TECH MAHINDRA, WIPRO, ONGC and many more. Approximately 25 percent student got internship in well reputed companies.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, workshops, library, gym, great classrooms, nice faculty, canteen was good and food there is great, there's a medical institution inside, games like basketball football indoors game like table tennis etc. and no AC's in classrooms.

faqs.question: How can candidates join SVU - Shri Venkateshwara University?
faqs.answer: Marks are determined using the combined IPE+AP EAMCET results. To acquire the rank under 5000 needed to get a free seat at SV UNIVERSITY, you need to score higher than 105+. Eamcet qualifying marks are 60, and there is no minimum score requirement for candidates who have reservations. Candidates must take the SVUCET entrance exam, which is offered by Sri Venkateswara University, to be considered for admission to all PG programs with the exception of the M.B.A. and M.C.A. programs.

college_info.intro:
Prin. N.G. Naralkar Institute of Career Development and Research offers specialisations in MBA, segregated in minor and major fields. The Institute offers MBA in Human Resource Management, Marketing Management, Financial Management, Operations and supply Chain management, Business Analytics, Agri -Business Management (ABM) and Pharma and Healthcare Management (PHM) as per the SPPU New Syllabus NEP 2024 pattern for MBA.
Admission to MBA at NICDR Pune is based on entrance. Mohamed Sathak College of Arts and Science - MSCAS offers entrance and merit-based admission to all its courses. Admission to all UG, PG, diploma and PhD courses is open. individual_reviews.title: Decent CSE and average packages.

content.Placements: Placements here are average overall. For CSE/IT, around 80-90 percent of students get placed mostly in IT firms like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Cognizant, Capgemini, and HCL. admission_process.title: CUJ Ranchi Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Central University of Jharkhand admissionis decided on entrance basis. TheCentral University of Jharkhandoffers more than twenty UG, PG and doctorate programmes under nine different schools. These courses are offered under various streams such asAccounting & Commerce,Engineering,Business & ManagementStudiesand many more. The university accepts CUET-UG, CUET-PG, etc. for admission to various courses, respectively.A majority of programmes are offered as integrated courses. Candidates can apply on the official website of the university after appearing for CUET. Apart from the UG and PG courses, candidates who are looking for PhD course admission must appear for the entrance exam. The university will conduct PhD entrance test for admission to PhD programme in the name of Central University of Jharkhand Research Entrance Test. Central University of Jharkhand course admissions are based on entrance exam scores.

CUJ Ranchi admissionto all of its offered programmes is entrance-based. The university offers an extensive range of programmes across several specialisations. All of the courses are in full-time and regular mode. The admissions begin with registration for CUET. Interested students can refer to the following table to learn more about importantCentral University of Jharkhandadmissionhighlights:

Central University of Jharkhand course admissionsfor its programmes are based on valid scores in the CUET. Besides, the university also accepts other national-level entrance exams for courses such as BTech, MTech, etc. Candidates are required to complete a minimum of Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG programmes. The university also conducts CUJRET for admissions to its PhD course. Students satisfying the eligibility conditions and desirous to take admission must participate in the online registration process by paying a non-refundable registration/counselling fee notified on the University website. Below are the eligibility and selection criteria for some of theCUJ Ranchi courses:

TheCentral University of Jharkhand feesis a combination of several fee components, such as tuition fees, security deposit, hostel fees, mess fees, and more. Some of the fee components are one-time payable while others are paid semester-wise. Aspirants will be able to get a refund on cancellation as per the university policy. Interested students can refer to the following table to know more aboutCUJ Ranchi feeand ROI for top courses:
Note:This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

TheCentral University of Jharkhand seat intakevaries course-wise. The university follows the reservation under all categories as per the regulations of the Government of India, UGC. Candidates can get a seat in the university based on their entrance exam scores. Once selected, admissions are confirmed only after payment of the course fee. Find below theCUJ Ranchi seat intakefor top courses:
Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

Central University of Jharkhand admission involves multiple steps such as application, selection, counselling, and admission confirmation. Students seeking admission to the course are required to fulfil the eligibility along with the selection criteria to secure a seat at the institute. The university accepts scores obtained in CUET UG and CUET PG for its UG and PG course admissions respectively. Eligible students can follow the below-mentioned steps to complete theCentral University of Jharkhand admission process:

Students must fill out the application form by filling in the specified information such as personal details, educational qualifications, etc. As the admissions are entrance-based, students are first required to apply and appear for the respective entrance tests. Those who meet theCUJ cutoffcan apply for the courses.

The university will shortlist the candidate on the basis of various factors, including scores of entrance tests, and past academic performances. Students who meet the university's admission criteria will be shortlisted. The university goes through a thorough selection process to shortlist the candidates for the courses.

Those who make it to the merit list will then have to go through counselling. The university will send an offer letter to the shortlisted candidates. To finalise the admission, the candidates are required to pay the admission fee for the desired course before the deadline along with submitting the payment receipt to the university. Students must submit the specified documents for verification, failure to do any of the above-mentioned steps will result in cancellation of admission.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members, placements, and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a library with sufficient study material. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms, 24/7 water and electricity. The average-quality food in the mess. Sports, medical facilities, and common areas are also well-maintained for students.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the course here and the study area, and with this, I love the food.
reviews.review_text: The new hostel is very good, food, and all things are good, but there is a very long distance to walk, and the food is excellent, and there are fewer markets nearby, but it is very good to study here because it feels good, and the sunset area is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: No hostel for education department.
reviews.review_text: University infrastructure is almost very good. Almost every class has smart board projectors and sound system along with traditional boards. Physics lab, chemistry lab, computer labs are available. Excellent Wi-Fi service is available. But for this education course, hostel is not available. B.Ed students are not eligible for hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Not bad and not very good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the department is good. There are many rooms for teaching. Every room has a smart board, and Wi-Fi is also provided by department. Sports scope is good in our department mainly in volleyball and cricket, both for girls and boys. Library is also present in the university.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is around 500 acres, very scenic, and full of nature.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are available. There are separate hostels for boys and girls, and separate buildings for UG and PG students too. There is a dispensary that is available for the students. Mess facilities are also provided with good-quality food.

reviews.review_heading: University is average, but faculty of some departments is good, especially my department (Korean).
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is currently under construction, which makes this university's infrastructure average. After the completion of the infrastructure, there's a separate building for the school of language, which helps the students a lot. The hostel of this college is of an average type.

reviews.review_heading: Descend University in Jharkhand.
reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi available across the campus, which is quite helpful for students. The labs are decent—not the best, but they get the job done. The library is nice and even has automated book issue machines, which makes things easier. Classrooms are well-maintained, and most of them have smart boards.

reviews.review_text: The college has decent Wi-Fi, a mess facility with good food provided in the best manner, and a library facility. reviews.review_heading: Life at Technocrats Institute.
reviews.review_text: Technocrats Institute of Technology has a very beautiful infrastructure, and Wi-Fi and smart classes are available in the college. The laboratories are designed very nicely according to AICTE standards. A 1000-seat auditorium is available. Hostel and mess are average.

reviews.review_heading: If you are looking for a private college in Bhopal for placement, then you can join it.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my college is one of the best infrastructures in Bhopal. There is no Wi-Fi for students. Classroom and library are okay. There is also a hostel inside and outside the campus. The food in mess is bad.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with average placement and its tuition feels
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good, with some of them having smart classes. Labs are also good, all the equipment needed is available here. The library is also good, all the books you need for your preparation are available. At the hostel, there are 6-seater rooms and 2-seater rooms with all the basic amenities.

reviews.review_heading: College fees are minimal, every student can afford to have good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college offers well-maintained infrastructure and modern facilities that contribute to a productive learning environment. Classrooms are spacious. The hostel facilities are good and have 24/7 security. The hostel provides basic amenities such as furnished rooms, mess facility, etc.

reviews.review_heading: College life never comes again.
reviews.review_text: My college has a big infrastructure, it has a big building in Bhopal. My college is fully furnished with Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and high-tech library. My college has separate boys' and girls ' campuses. The quality of food is also very good, and the taste of food is also good. Medical and sports facilities are also available. College also provides us with so many tournaments, like cricket and football matches.

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing. It provides the environment for studies as well as growth.
reviews.review_text: Campus of the college is too much attractive. The campus is very wide, large, and beautiful. The campus of the college is around 35 acres of land, and the campus is full of greenery. They provided an environment for studies to the students of the colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent placements and faculty but the strict fine system is the worst part.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good infrastructure with well-equipped labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, a library, and sports facilities. It also has industry-supported labs by Capgemini and KPIT that help students gain practical knowledge. The campus has two boys' hostels and a girls' hostel nearby. Hostel facilities are decent, though maintenance can sometimes be better. The canteen and mess food is average but manageable, and basic medical facilities are available on campus. Overall, the infrastructure su...

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing in everything.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this college is very good. There are many buildings available in the college. The area and the size of the college are around thirty-five acres. The college is located outside the city, and the average placement of this college is much better compared to other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is world-class, like that of the Indian Institute of Technology. The college is white in colour. The area of the college is spread over 35 acres. The campus is full of greenery.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Bhopal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities available for my course are one of the best among all courses, with 24X7 hours of outstanding Wi-Fi, fully AC classrooms, and a good library. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is decent. The medical facilities are top-notch. There is a huge sports ground where you can play any games.

reviews.review_heading: This college is too good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is next level as compared to other colleges that are available in the college of Bhopal and in Madhya Pradesh. There are too many big and wide campuses of the college that create an encouraging and supportive environment for the students.

reviews.review_heading: It is known for its placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure, including buildings, classrooms, labs, and the library, are all well-arranged with the latest books and equipment. The facilities provided in the hostel are good, and the food quality is not bad for a hostel. Medical facilities are there, but you will not get a career in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: This review contains an honest view of our college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure seems decent, and I don't roam around the campus too much. But overall the infrastructure is good and very well-maintained. The hostel facilities are not for boys and girls, so we have to rent a PG. Campus is full of Wi-Fi and air-conditioned classes also in some rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Better option in Bhopal for placements.
reviews.review_text: College campus is very beautiful with lush green gardens and well-maintained buildings and classrooms. In the library, every book is available, and AC is there. Labs are decent, but some equipment are not updated to the new version. Hostel facilities are good, and the quality of food is decent with a variety of options for snacks.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with lower fees.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are the facilities available in my department. There's not a single problem with them, as far as the library is concerned, except when you have to, when there are classes scheduled. Otherwise, you can't randomly go out there and do whatever you want to do. All the things, such as sports, games, medical facilities, canteen, and mess, are also good. There's no problem with related stuff.

paragraphs: NICMAR Hyderabad admission 2025is entirely entrance-based. The institute offers admission to PG courses in Advanced Construction Management, Advanced Project Management, one-year PGP in Quantity Surveying and Contract Management among others. As perNICMAR Hyderabadadmission process, the institute conductsPG-NCAT (Written Test), followed by group discussion, personal interview round, and rating of application. The institute also admits students on management quota. However, various state/ national-level entrance exams related to management programme are also accepted for NICMAR course admission.

The college offers various courses in multiple specialisations and aspirants need to apply through the official website.Candidates can read the table below to learn more on NICMAR Hyderabad admission highlights 2025:
NOTE:The information available in the above table is sourced from the official website.

NICMAR Hyderabad admission is offered to PGP courses in all specialisations. The selection process consists of fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria and qualifying for all the selection parameters. However, final-year students can also apply for courses. Check below the eligibility and selection criteria for some ofNICMAR Hyderabad courses:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Architecture / Planning with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognized Institution/ University
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Architecture / Planning with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognized Institution/ University

NICMAR Hyderabad Admission Process is a multi-step process, that students must follow to get into the college. Starting with filling out the NICMAR application form, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds. After the selection rounds are over, the college releases a merit list on the official website (with the names of the shortlisted students) of the college post which interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Candidates can check the step-wise detailed process for NICMAR Hyderabad admission 2025 in the following section:

Students interested in getting into NICMAR Hyderabad must submit the online application form for all PGP courses at (nicmar.ac.in/hyderabad/admissions). The NICMAR application process is completely conducted in online mode. Along with that, they must also pay an application fee of INR 2,000.
Step 2: NICMAR Selection Criteria 2025 & Release of Merit List

After the applications are submitted, students are required to appear for CUET (PG)/ CET/ PG-NCAT (Written Test)/ CAT/ MAT/ ATMA, followed by GDPI + RA round. After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website (with the names of the shortlisted students) of the university.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation at NICMAR Hyderabad
Post the selection rounds, short-listed candidates with their names on the merit lists can submit the fee and confirm their admission to the relevant course at NICMAR Hyderabad.
